title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia's chief executive
caption: Nvidia announced Thursday that co-founder Jensen Huang had stepped down as CEO and from its board, effective immediately, after 33 years leading the chipmaker; CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO. Shares fell as much as 14% before closing down about 4%. The exit followed days of reports about Huang's personal relationships and related national security questions, which the company says it is investigating.

stories.name: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO
facts: On Thursday, Nov. 12, Nvidia announced that co-founder Jensen Huang had stepped down as CEO and from its board, effective immediately, after 33 years leading the chipmaker.
CFO Colette Kress was named interim CEO while keeping her finance role; Harvey C. Jones became the board's first-ever chair. The board will consider internal and external candidates.
The exit followed days of reports about Huang's personal relationships and related national security questions, which Nvidia said it was investigating; Huang made no public statement reported.
Nvidia shares fell as much as 14% early Thursday, then recovered to close down about 4.3%.

artwork.alt: Seen from rows of empty seats in a dark auditorium, a single spotlight falls on a bare stool on an empty stage, with a black leather jacket hung over its back. Behind it a giant glowing green computer chip fills the stage screen, circuit traces radiating outward, and a red share-price line plunges and then climbs part of the way back. It represents Jensen Huang's resignation as Nvidia CEO and the day's drop in the company's stock.
